breakpoints.note: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled DER witness and materializes it into the PKCS#12 ASN.1 tree later traversed by gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.

gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag assumes oid is safe for a fixed-literal strcmp after asn1_read_value, but it never initializes the bytes beyond the returned OID string. For the witness the inner contentType (DER 06 01 07) decodes to a short dotted OID string, so asn1_read_value fills only that prefix and leaves oid's tail untouched; the later 21-byte strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) reaches those uninitialized bytes, which MSAN reports. A correct fix zero-initializes oid before the read (or avoids fixed-literal comparison that inspects bytes beyond the initialized prefix).
